Want to know what's really happening at school? 🎒 Don't just ask "How was school?"

Sophie is eight. Every day the answer is the same: "Fine." So her mom started asking better questions:
❓ Who did you eat lunch with? 🥪
❓ Did anyone say or do something that made you uncomfortable?
❓ Who did you laugh with today? 😄
❓ Did you feel left out at all?
❓ Did anything make you feel bad about yourself?
❓ Was there anything you were afraid to tell me?
❓ What was the best and the hardest part of your day?

Question four opened the door. 🚪 "Nobody let me play." 😢 Kids shouldn't have to carry problems alone.

The goal isn't to interrogate. It's to make home the place where she always comes home and tells you. ❤️

"Pour out your heart before him; God is a refuge for us." Psalm 62:8 (ESV) 🙏 Jesus carried the heaviest load of all, so we never have to carry ours alone.

Two weeks later, Sophie starts it herself: "Mom, can I tell you something?" 🥹

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
